"Welcome to Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi Keyboard! This app supports typing, voice input, and AI features. During use, we'll connect to the internet and request the necessary permissions. You can also choose one of the following privacy modes: Agree to the terms and conditions and turn on Full experience mode: Get efficient voice input and AI features. Some input data will be encrypted and sent to the cloud for features such as AI replies and actions, voice recognition, and personalized hotwords. The original text won't be stored. Decline the terms and conditions and turn on Basic typing mode: No data will be collected. You can only use basic typing services. AI, voice, and other features won't be available. "

For questions, visit Xiaomi Privacy Support to contact us. We'll reply within %2$s business days. By tapping \"Agree\", you're agreeing to the data collection described above."
